landing.eyebrow: Calibration management for Indian manufacturing plants
landing.subtitle: Every instrument, due date, purchase order, delivery challan, lab certificate and out-of-tolerance decision in one place — and a one-click audit pack when the IATF 16949 or ISO 9001 auditor walks in.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything clause 7.1.5 asks for, without the spreadsheets
landing.featuresSubtitle: From the first instrument you import to the certificate the auditor asks for.
landing.f1d: Make, range, least count, standard, adjustability, location and full history for every gauge. QR labels you can scan on the shop floor.
landing.f2d: Planning dates set days before each due date. Daily 09:00 digest by email and WhatsApp, with escalation for anything overdue.
landing.f3d: Instruments go to the cheapest eligible NABL lab under contract, or out for quotes. GST-correct purchase orders in one click.
landing.f4d: Returnable challans with 16-character numbering, gate passes, and receipt by scanning — partial returns and overdue tracking included.
landing.f5d: Side-by-side PDF and checklist: ULR, NABL mark, accreditation number and scope checked automatically; readings judged point by point. Optional AI reading.
landing.f6d: A failed calibration puts the gauge on hold and opens a case: impact on products since the last good calibration, quality-head disposition, CAPA.
landing.f7d: Register, overdue list, calibrations, OOT cases, lab accreditation and every certificate — one indexed, page-numbered PDF.
landing.f8d: Vendor on-time %, turnaround and OOT rate, calibration spend by lab and month, at-lab aging — all exportable to Excel.
landing.howSubtitle: Most plants are running in a day.
landing.s1d: Upload your existing register — messy columns are fine.
landing.s2d: Raise calibration requests from the due list.
landing.s3d: POs to labs, challan and gate pass for dispatch.
landing.s4d: Check each certificate; failures open an OOT case.
landing.s5d: Generate the audit pack for any plant and period.
landing.indiaTitle: Built for how Indian plants actually work
